New feature

Domain tags

It had been requested some time ago and I got around to writing it. It wasn't particularly hard but I played around with svg icons...

This module will add a default icon after all domain names in submissions elements. Clicking this icon will display the tagbox (shown below) in which you can choose a label and a colour (by clicking the colour dot), but you don't have to choose a label, a colour alone will do. Once created, the icon will change to this, showing the colour you chose. Mouse over this icon will show the tag in a tooltip.

You can tag external and internal domains. Internals ones would be links displayed by self-texts (like self.whatever).

I tried to make this feature very minimalistic, It shouldn't be intrusive. I hope this didn't make it hard to use.

Also, what do you guys prefer to choose the tag colour: a dot separated from the text input ( light, dark) or attached (light, dark)?

This module will be added to the dashboard soon, also I will add an option to tag domains as ignored.

This feature is disabled by default, I figured not everybody would use it and since it loops over all submissions in a page it could have an effect on performances (even if I optimized it like I did with the usertag module; ~30ms). You can enable it by going in the new tab "Domains" in the preference manager.

You can't remove a domain tag for the moment. You will have to wait for the dashboard implementation for that, sorry.

Changes

Usertags

  • Added an option to display the vote balance over a colour gradient (light, dark) going from red (negative votes) to green (positive votes). As you can see in the images, the gradient maxes out at 100 and -100, would you need a wider range?

  • The dashboard has been updated to account for the context entry, also choosing a colour is now done with a colour palette instead of a text input.
  • I worked a lot on optimizing the data saved by this module. It used to save a whole tag object every time, even if only the vote balance had been modified and no tag existed.
